sources.name: Web Data Commons JSON-LD / Microdata corpus 2024 (Oct 2024 Common Crawl)
sources.notes: Restricted to the Hotel, LodgingBusiness, Restaurant, FAQPage and BreadcrumbList subsets. Streamed per record; never loaded whole.

sources.name: WDC Schema.org Table Corpus 2023
sources.notes: Table-shaped structured data; used for schema field coverage only.

sources.name: Common Crawl WARC / WET via cdx_toolkit
sources.licence: Common Crawl Terms of Use; page text remains the owners' copyright
sources.notes: Structure + labels only (structure of the markup, page-type labels). Body prose is never copied into a target. Prefer archived captures over live crawling.

sources.name: Lighthouse run on your own crawl
sources.notes: Labels produced from our own crawl, cross-checked against the rules engine.

sources.name: Wikidata hotel entities
sources.notes: Entity grounding for GEO (name, location, brand, amenities as facts).

sources.name: schema.org vocabulary repository (data/)
sources.notes: Validation and synthetic templates only, not bulk text. Attribution required in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and docs/ATTRIBUTION.md.

sources.name: Google Search Central documentation
sources.notes: RAG corpus for the audit explainer. Every retrieved chunk keeps its source URL so recommendations can cite it. Attribution required.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap tourism=hotel
sources.notes: Seed URL list only, kept as a separate database (ODbL share-alike must not be absorbed into the training corpus). Attribution required.

sources.name: HTTP Archive on BigQuery (free tier 1 TB/month)
sources.notes: Classifier eval only until the terms are confirmed. Flip to train after review.

sources.name: GEO-bench (Hugging Face GEO-Optim/geo-bench)
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0, derived from MS MARCO / ORCAS
sources.notes: EVALUATION ONLY. Derived from MS MARCO/ORCAS (non-commercial research only), so it must never enter a train split — this includes using it as a source of training examples or distillation targets.

sources.name: MS MARCO (Microsoft)
sources.notes: Forbidden as training data. Do not derive, remix or distil from it.

sources.name: ORCAS (Microsoft)
sources.notes: Forbidden as training data. Also blocks GEO-bench from training.

sources.name: HotelRec (TripAdvisor reviews)
sources.notes: Forbidden as training data. URL omitted on purpose — verify before any use.

sources.name: Chrome extension training vault (approved records)
sources.notes: Only records with consent: true. stripPii before storage and before export.

sources.name: healing/ approved and rejected patches
sources.notes: Approved -> chosen, rejected -> rejected for DPO pairs.

sources.name: Reviewed / gold TrainingTriples
sources.notes: TRAINING_ELIGIBLE_TIERS only (reviewed, gold). Subject to MIN_REVIEWED_PAIRS_FOR_TRAINING = 2000 for client-derived rows.

sources.name: Existing data/training/unified_seo_*.jsonl
sources.notes: Train only after re-validation through the extended validator.
